false_positive.cause: The detector counted standard category labels and the storage breadcrumb but did not require the vertical list geometry unique to an open left drawer.

root_cause.summary: The r32 roots-drawer detector relied on label co-occurrence and left-side bounds but did not distinguish a vertical drawer list from category chips and a two-column storage grid.
details: The positive open-drawer path worked and entered the storage root.
On the resulting ordinary storage page, repeated category labels and a storage breadcrumb satisfied the same coarse detector.
The repair hit a visible enabled element that the detector mislabeled as a roots row and opened Notifications instead of Music.
The development run was stopped immediately; no evaluator result, destination commit, or formal authorization was produced.

r33_required_change.scope: Geometric discrimination between the open left roots drawer and the ordinary Android Files content page.
mechanism: Require standard roots/category controls to occupy at least four distinct vertical row bands before declaring the roots drawer open.
Keep the existing label, visibility, enabled-state, left-panel, and usable-storage-row requirements.
Add a negative regression fixture with same-row category chips, a storage breadcrumb, and two-column folder tiles.
Preserve the visible-row hit contract only after the stronger drawer predicate passes.
prohibited: Changing the 20-step budget, model, seed, evaluator, tasks, schedule, or acceptance thresholds
